Unlocking Data Initiative, then CERT at the University of Malawi

note: The document names the EMIS as holding the largest foundational learning dataset but states no census run, learner record or link; the EDaP is a research data portal, not the ministry's system.

facts.fact: The Unlocking Data Initiative policy brief says cohort tracking within the EMIS generates longitudinal learner-level data through Learner Identification Numbers assigned to pupils on entry to school, though the data has rarely been analysed since 2012.
Malawi's Ministry of Education says it is moving from fragmented reporting towards a more connected EMIS and has developed a five-pillar EMIS governance framework including a national data warehouse.
Unlocking Data Initiative Malawi, with HISP-UNIMA, says a DHIS2-based EMIS is currently being piloted in Dedza and Machinga.

The newsletter says a DHIS2-based cohort tracking prototype, described as a component of Malawi's EMIS, is running in four pilot schools, with validation expected by end-June 2026 before presentation to Ministry management for adoption.
